verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows WorkOS offering a self-managed deployment, a private or single-tenant instance, or a bring-your-own-database option; all documentation describes a hosted platform reached through its API. Vault BYOK (encryption keys in AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or Azure Key Vault) and the user-data migration tooling are adjacent features that do not control where the auth system or its user data runs. Community comments also note that customers cannot run it in their own environment, such as under AWS Marketplace.
